fact: The World Bank reports the Rwanda Revenue Authority launched M-Declaration on 5 October 2013, letting small businesses declare profit tax by phone and pay by bank account or mobile money; an e-filing facility already existed.

ICTD says electronic tax filing and tax payment systems have been mandatory in Rwanda since 2015, with e-service take-up among surveyed income-taxpayers reaching 90 per cent by two years into the pandemic.
KT Press says citizens can pay fees through online platforms such as Irembo, with electronic payments via Mobile Money and Airtel Money.
